# Projects

The root has a single visible folder, so pressing Enter opens this column and
a second Enter opens `design` as the third column.

## Contents

- [Layout notes](design/layout-notes.md)
- [Type scale](design/type-scale.md)
- [Colour tokens](design/color-tokens.md)

| Folder | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| design | layout, type and colour references |

> The column header should read `projects · 3 items` (localised) and the
> breadcrumb should read `Root / projects`, never the repository twice.
